prompt: In a bustling medieval market square, a cobblestone plaza is dotted with ten wooden stalls, each covered by a striped canvas awning. A baker’s stall displays freshly baked bread loaves beside a ceramic pie dish, while a fruit vendor’s stand boasts baskets of apples, pears, and grapes. Nearby, a blacksmith hammers at an anvil next to a row of iron horseshoes and a leather quiver hanging on a post. A jeweler’s table holds gold rings, silver necklaces, and a velvet pouch, and a spice merchant shows sacks of cinnamon, peppercorns, and saffron. A wooden barrel filled with olives sits beside a clay amphora of olive oil. A juggler tosses three colorful balls by a carved wooden fountain, while two musicians play lutes under a stone archway. A goose waddles past a woven wicker basket of eggs. There is no glass window, no modern sign, no plastic toy, no electric lamp, and no paper poster.
